x: Among these are Earle, Aris, Adey, Seddon, Armstrong, Jarvis, Crowe, Burns and Brian, the winner of our recent Novice Walk. We wish our new friends a very long association with the Club, and much success in the future!
Wright, Earle, Burns and the others in their first year will find that each race brings its modicum of experience, and next year will find them battling with the more experienced.
Our "D" team (Wright, Readman, Goold and Earle) took the first handicap team prizes, and so we can consider we had our share.

Elson, Heather, Goold, Jarvis, Boddington, Snell Hamer, Spooner, Cornish, Joe Coleman, Earle, Urry, Clark, Pattenden, Willis, True and several others, some beginners, who are showing rapid improvement.
Boddington, Clark, Earle, and Jarvis, being second. Fifteen of the first 52 to finish the course were Belgrave Harriers, which is a splendid indication of good all-round strength.
Douglas Earle walked splendidly and his fastest race yet to take second position; with George Boddington repeating his good walking of our "Open" event and being placed third.

Derek's reply was to up his best yet again, as he placed 2nd with 7.30 behind Earle (BRC) 7.39 and ahead of Wade (AAA) 7.16. John Bicourt made a guest appearance in the 2,000 'chase, timed at 5:49.0 for 5th.
